verdict.rationale: Gusto's own compliance page lists registered agent service. It states that when Gusto is your registered agent, your filing address stays private and your mail is monitored and routed to you through Gusto, which is supported by its government mail monitoring feature. However, it never says the mail is scanned or that service of process is handled digitally. missing for 10: explicit scanned/digital mail delivery, explicit service-of-process handling and notification, independent or hands-on corroboration of the registered agent workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the platform as my registered agent and receive scanned legal mail and service of process digitally

citations.quote: When Gusto is your registered agent, your filing address stays private, and your mail is monitored and routed to you through Gusto.
